documents.title: Natural Earth 1:50m — physical coastline repair for post-1991 RF archive captures
documents.publicationCitation: Natural Earth vector, ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson, pinned source commit ca96624a; vendored as public/data/territory/cultural/countries_50m.geojson.
documents.notes: The RF source archive contains maritime envelopes and displaced offshore components. All countries are dissolved into one physical land mask, so their modern political boundaries cannot replace the dated mainland frontier. Only the explicitly indexed offshore Russian island components are added; mainland Russia, western Chukotka, Kaliningrad and Crimea are excluded from this addition. Independent Belovezha and RF–China documents continue to establish the period and legal track. The 1:50m coastline is generalized and does not establish a maritime boundary, resolve sovereignty disputes or support cadastral precision. Runivers is solely an external comparison, never a production geometry source.
